title: Hausdorff measure of closed discs in an n-plane (Hⁿ(W ∩ B̄(y, ρ)) = ofReal(ρⁿ)·ω, ω < ∞)
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ and let W be a linear subspace of ℝ^N = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) with dim W = n. Let Hⁿ := μHE[n] (Mathlib's Euclidean-normalized n-dimensional Hausdorff measure on ℝ^N), B̄(y, ρ) := {x : |x − y| ≤ ρ} and ω := Hⁿ(W ∩ B̄(0, 1)). Then ω < ∞, and for every y ∈ W and every real ρ ≥ 0, Hⁿ(W ∩ B̄(y, ρ)) = ENNReal.ofReal(ρⁿ) · ω.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (W : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), finrank ℝ W = n → μHE[n] ((W : Set (Rn N)) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 1) < ∞ ∧ ∀ y ∈ W, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 ≤ ρ → μHE[n] ((W : Set (Rn N)) ∩ Metric.closedBall y ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) * μHE[n] ((W : Set (Rn N)) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 1)
